# Papa Bravo

> Papa Bravo AB is a Swedish company in technology, product, consulting and transformation. Pontus Burman is the founder and the senior consultant clients engage.

Pontus Burman helps organisations with technology leadership, product and transformation — from strategy and organisation through to delivery. He is based in Stockholm, Sweden, and takes assignments in Sweden and internationally.

Relevant work includes interim CTO, interim CIO, fractional CTO, technology advisor, technology and digital transformation, product and technology leadership, and programme leadership. He still builds and operates digital products, which is part of how the consulting stays close to delivery.

## Products

- My Star Day (Min Stjärndag): https://mystarday.app and https://mystarday.se — family routines, structure and motivation. Live on the web, App Store and Google Play.
- Körpasset: https://korpasset.se — structured private driving practice in Sweden. Live on the web and the App Store. Android is in review with Google.

## Not claimed

The site does not publish client logos as “trusted by”, testimonials, user counts, revenue, savings or other results that are not stated as such. Papa Bravo is not described as a large organisation, and not as a one-person practice.
